name: Band Shoulder External Rotation in Neutral
steps: Anchor a resistance band at elbow height.
Stand sideways to the anchor point with the target arm on the outside.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees and hold the band handle across your belly, placing a rolled towel between your elbow and ribs.
Keeping your elbow pinned firmly to your side, rotate your forearm outward away from your body against the band's resistance.
Pause at peak external rotation for one second, then slowly return your forearm across your stomach.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbow pinned to the towel roll; do not allow your elbow to flare away from your ribs.
Maintain an upright posture and avoid twisting your torso to help move the band.
Move with smooth, steady control in both directions.

sources.attribution: Cornell Health Shoulder Band Strengthening Protocol
